conditions.runtime: Dedicated server BloodMoonLoot cleanup of objects implementing Container

change.summary: Blood Moon invalidation inspects only materialized inventory and never opens pending native loot tables during chunk/entity loading

before.value: Every chunk/entity container is read slot by slot, including pending native loot tables and worlds without invalidation history

after.value: Invalidation requires recorded invalidated attempts, pending native block/vehicle loot tables stay lazy, already materialized marked items retain existing removal rules

rationale.purpose: Keep Chunky pregeneration and normal chunk loading from materializing structure loot through unrelated event cleanup
rationale.decision_source: User requested Chunky-generated shared Xaero terrain and a local test jem trial. The exact cleanup guards are a Codex implementation decision based on crash-2026-10-24_14.06.21-server.txt and native 1.20.1 container contracts.

introduced.summary: Requested local Chunky/Xaero compatibility trial exposed a watchdog crash from BloodMoonLoot reading pending chest loot. Codex selected an invalidation-work guard and native pending-loot detection. Player acceptance remains in testing.

history.summary: Requested local Chunky/Xaero compatibility trial exposed a watchdog crash from BloodMoonLoot reading pending chest loot. Codex selected an invalidation-work guard and native pending-loot detection. Player acceptance remains in testing.

relations: ChunkEvent.Load -> BloodMoonLoot.scrubInvalid -> Container.getItem -> native loot generation
notes: Pending native loot tables cannot contain materialized event-marked loot. Player inventories, existing container contents, rewards and attempt invalidation ownership are retained. No watchdog timeout or upstream loot rule is changed.
unresolved: Fresh artifact/runtime and user acceptance remain in testing until observed separately. MapSyncer 1.0.3 has a separate observed AIR reflection error and is only a local trial candidate.
